notes: C++ leaves the evaluation order of the two converter_ calls unspecified; LOSAT draws for the first letter before the second (GCC gimplifies the left operand first). No effect found: in 15,000 constructed sequences with NN exactly at the restart position (random prefix, NN, then a 62-letter microsatellite tail), a Python port of dust.rs gives the same intervals with either draw order, and the oracle-vs-port comparison over about 2,900 other sequences with N runs (many restarts) had no difference. A leading NN in a query cannot be compared through the dustmasker application (it trims terminal N runs), so that exact case rests on the same code path as the restart case.
